name: b11-shared-variance-direction-replication
purpose: Audit whether the earlier B11 position-group direction result survives one pooled scalar variance denominator
prior_measurement: experiments_history.md B11 2026-08-16: 25 held-out shots, 60 frames per group, 0.584/0.803/0.492 normalized-form distances; diagnose_regime.py used a separate scalar variance for each group

jacobian.delta_source: rounded diagnostic step reported in compact-production base_s0 run log: 300/300 probes, step 0.06092 Wb/rad; no tuning
jacobian.complete_triplet_rule: A shot contributes only if all three position probes have finite baseline values and all 7x50 Jacobian entries; never replace a failed position
jacobian.variance: population variance ddof=0 of each scalar over every frame in the complete finite triplets, pooled across all three position groups
jacobian.scalar_weights: W_CONS times the artifact's original normalized loss.cons_split weights, divided by the same pooled variance in every group

comparisons.normalization: divide each 50x50 group-mean form by its trace; report raw traces separately
comparisons.pair_distance: Frobenius norm of the difference between trace-normalized forms divided by the mean of their Frobenius norms
comparisons.primary_dispersion: arithmetic mean of the three pair distances
comparisons.legacy_denominator_control: Recompute forms on exactly the same complete probes with scalar variance estimated separately within each group; report their traces and normalized distances, not used for the gate

permutation_null.shuffle: For every complete shot, independently permute its three position labels; preserve one frame per group and all within-shot values

bootstrap_uncertainty.denominator: hold the observed pooled scalar variances fixed so this reflects shot sampling of Jacobian orientation under one common metric

screening_gate.meaning: Mechanism screen only; passing is not evidence of a competition score gain or authorization to implement a per-row loss

if_incomplete: With fewer than 90 complete finite shots, report inconclusive rather than replace frames or tune the sample
